name: 施欣文
objective:
本課程旨在介紹應用語言學 / 文學文化各領域重要議題與研究趨勢，以提供研究生在準備寫作研究論文時研究方向討論及導引。
This course introduces the main sub-disciplines, key issues and research trends in Applied Linguistics/Literature and Culture. It aims to provide graduate students with the fundamental knowledge and guidance needed for preparing and writing a research paper.
schedule: Students will meet with various professors to discuss students' current thesis research plans and which advisors might be the best fit. Students are encouraged to be open to more than one possible topic as they seek an advisor.
scorePolicy: Students will be graded based on their punctuality to the meeting, their willingness to engage throughout the meeting, and their final research product (the proposal they write at the end of the course).
materials: We will use various handouts, databases, and websites.
課程是否導入AI: ● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
